regions.text: その特色を有つてるる。

quote.translation: The three systems of Modality, moreover, each view the modalities from a different standpoint, and every one of them has its own distinctive features.

regions.text: 一を取り他を捨てるべき性質のものでは決してない偶然

quote.translation: They are by no means of such a nature that one should be taken up and the others discarded.

regions.text: 性の構造もこの三つの見地から粽合釣に目警して初めて完全に把握されるのである。三つの體系の協力を力説すべきである。

quote.translation: The structure of contingency, too, is grasped completely only when it is witnessed synthetically from these three points of view, and the cooperation of the three systems must be emphasised.

regions.text: 以上に於て我々は主として可能性乃至不可能性との開係に基いて偶然性を考察

quote.translation: Up to this point we have considered contingency mainly on the basis of its relation to possibility or impossibility.

regions.text: して來たのであるが衒やうな考察は異へられた現實または存在の背後に立つて發展の動向を出發動に於て窺ふことを意味してるる。

quote.translation: A consideration of this kind means standing behind the given actual or existence and glimpsing, at its starting point, the direction in which it develops, and for that, the actual or existence must be seen from the disjunctive standpoint.

regions.text: それには現質または存在を離接的立場から見なければならない。甲は乙なるか丙なるか丁なるかであるといふやうに、離接

quote.translation: In the form "A is either B, or C, or D", that is, disjunctive possibility, and with it impossibility, is made the background of the actual.

regions.text: 的な可能性を、更にまた不可能性を、現實の背景とするのである。

quote.translation: Let us consider the case in which, taking in the disjunctive possibility that belongs to the faces of a die, we engage in the play of chance.

regions.text: 賽の目の有つ離接的可能性を取入れて偶然の遠機をする場合を考へて見よう。およそ饗ころの現はす一定の面を偶然の性格を有つものとするのは六つ

quote.translation: The reason that a particular face shown by a die is in general taken to have the character of the contingent is that it is thought against the background of the possibility of six faces, which is to say that we think it could equally have been any of the other five.
